# GaussianField

Michael R. Douglas's [GaussianField](https://github.com/mrdouglasny/gaussian-field),
pinned at [`1283a2721377a36e80672799fcc1f69a494c8ea0`](https://github.com/mrdouglasny/gaussian-field/tree/1283a2721377a36e80672799fcc1f69a494c8ea0),
is released under the [Apache 2.0 license](LICENSE).

[`HermiteFunctions.lean`](HermiteFunctions.lean) is the one-dimensional Hermite analysis
from `SchwartzNuclear/HermiteFunctions.lean`. It supplies the real L² orthonormality and
completeness and the Schwartz seminorm growth used in the complex Euclidean estimates
for #2837. [`SOURCE_MAP.json`](SOURCE_MAP.json) records the upstream file hash.
